description: Acquired all governed evidence: task statement and deliverable spec, the W371 rule (weights 3,7,1 cycling right-to-left, rightmost payload digit weight 3; check digit (10 - (S mod 10)) mod 10), the 8 validate identifiers and 4 compute payloads, the unresolved distinctions Q1-Q4, and the governing contract and harness.

First derivation (E-A): spec-faithful per-item W371 computation for all 12 items with full weighted-sum tables — weights assigned right-to-left with the rightmost payload digit at weight 3, weighted sum S, check digit (10 - (S mod 10)) mod 10, and comparison against each validate identifier's final digit. Results: VALID/VALID/INVALID/INVALID/VALID/VALID/VALID/INVALID for the validate items in listed order; check digits 9, 3, 3, 7 for the compute payloads in listed order. Method stated in result.json as E-A requires; resolutions persisted in resolution.json.

In-session read-only cross-check (non-authoritative): every validate item re-checked via the congruence form (identifier valid iff S plus its final digit is congruent to 0 mod 10) with independently re-tabulated right-to-left sums (S = 103, 143, 170, 154, 129, 115, 135, 97), and every compute payload re-summed right-to-left (S = 101, 127, 137, 133); all 12 outcomes agree with ev-2. result.json checked against package/task.json deliverable shape: answers object with exactly the 12 required 'validate:<id>' / 'compute:<payload>' keys plus a method statement. NOT admissible for Q3 (same session holds the first derivation's intermediate work) and not authoritative for Q4 (deterministic root verification governs).

Examiner charge (creator bookkeeping, proposed at authoring time): instructions for the root-executed verify-independent examiner to produce the E-B disjoint re-derivation — full-sum congruence check for validate items and left-to-right weighting with explicit phase correction for compute items — with a strict non-consultation rule (derivations.md forbidden; result.json answers read only after the examiner's own answers are fixed) and a per-item agreement report.
